name: message-payload
prompt: Create a Payload record and Worker domain. Send a Payload with value 41 to a read-only handler that replies with its value, then mutate the caller's original payload to 42 and print both values.
success_criteria: The message payload is read-only in the handler.
The original remains available after the synchronous value boundary.
notes: Exercises message payload snapshot/value semantics and post-message caller use.
